The literal `shuffle_unit` function in `shuffle.py` comes from `model/make_model.py` at [damo-cv/TransReID commit dec55046fcdfadee14e2c28e2df89305d8f7557a](https://github.com/damo-cv/TransReID/blob/dec55046fcdfadee14e2c28e2df89305d8f7557a/model/make_model.py). Its MIT notice is retained in LICENSE and shuffle.py.

The surrounding fish adapter is implemented in cfp/transreid_dino_jpm.py. It preserves the original JPM shift=5/group=2/four equal floor-sized subsets, two independent copies of the final block and norm, one shared local block, five BN necks/classifiers, half-global/half-local loss weighting and after-neck concatenation with each local descriptor divided by four. With the DINO 9×18 patch grid, each part contains 40 tokens and the final two shuffled tokens are omitted, as prescribed by the source's floor division.

This is a mechanism adaptation, not an official TransReID reproduction: it uses the same pinned DINOv2-S as the fish controls, trains a penultimate block and copied final branches, omits camera/view SIE, and uses video-key physical labels with temporal same-video positives and same-frame negatives. Prefix CLS and patches already mix the entire crop; shuffled parts are not anatomical regions or purely local evidence. The equal-capacity control supplies repeated prefix CLS to the four local branches while retaining their sequence lengths, weights, BN necks and supervision. BN running states fit only on the four training videos; excluded-video evaluation and deployment use eval mode.
